name: It's no skin off my nose

meaning.zh:
“与我无关” 或 “对我没有影响”。

这个短语最早出现在20世纪初的英国，原意是比喻某件事对自己没有实际的损伤或影响。它通常用来表达某人对某件事情无所谓，或觉得这件事不会对自己的情绪、利益产生影响。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in early 20th-century Britain. It was a figurative way of saying that something does not cause actual harm or impact. It's often used to express indifference or indicate that something won't affect one's emotions or interests.

lines.en: You can take the last slice of cake; it's no skin off my nose.
lines.zh: 你可以拿最后一块蛋糕，与我无关。

lines.en: If he wants to leave the team, it's no skin off my nose.
lines.zh: 如果他想离开球队，对我没有影响。

lines.en: Whether you choose to go or stay, it's no skin off my nose.
lines.zh: 无论你选择去还是留，这与我无关。
